senses.gloss: f. (שור; b. h.;, Ez. XXVII, 25) caravan.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 7:13">Tosef. B. Mets. VII, 13</cite> <he>ש׳ שהיתה מהלכת וכ׳</he> if a caravan travels in the desert, and a band attacks and robs it &c.; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 116b:10">B. Kam. 116ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:10:6">Y. Erub. I, end, 19ᵈ</cite> <he>אהלים שבש׳ וכ׳</he> tents put up by a caravan require no ‘Erub (v. <cite ref="P00680"><he>עֵירוּב</he></cite>), opp. <he>שבמחנה</he> in a camp; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁיָירוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 18a:11">B. Mets. 18ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02262"><he>מָצָא</he></cite>; a. fr.—Ch., v. <cite ref="U00914"><he>שְׁיַירְתָּא</he></cite>.
